blocks.heading: Request for Permission to Print or Use the Office’s Publications and Media
blocks.lead: Request permission to print or use publications, electronic media, electronic data and other media of the Office of the Royal Society under the Office of the Royal Society Regulation on Permission to Print and Disseminate Publications, Electronic Media, Electronic Data and Other Media, B.E. 2561 (2018).

blocks.heading: Apply Online

consent.text: I acknowledge and agree to comply with the Office of the Royal Society Regulation on Permission to Print and Disseminate Publications, Electronic Media, Electronic Data and Other Media, B.E. 2561 (2018), and all specified conditions.

terms.title: Read the conditions for permit holders
items: The permit holder must use the permitted work without seeking commercial or business gain, whether directly or indirectly.

The permit holder must strictly preserve the accuracy of the content, format and punctuation of the original prepared by the Office of the Royal Society. Otherwise, the grantor may order the printing, use or dissemination to be suspended, and the permit holder shall have no right to claim any damages whatsoever from the Office of the Royal Society. During printing, use and dissemination, the grantor may require the permit holder to submit evidence or details, including copies of the permitted publications, electronic media, electronic data or other media, for verification.

The Office of the Royal Society will provide a statement of permission specifying all conditions set by the grantor, which the permit holder must print in the preface or display at the beginning of the permitted publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media.

The permit holder must not print or display any other text or articles not copyrighted by the Office of the Royal Society in the publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media, unless permitted by the grantor.

The cover of any publication, electronic media, electronic data or other media to be distributed or used at an event must be printed or displayed as specified by the grantor, showing the title, author, event date and venue. Pictures or patterns in garish colours must not be printed unless permitted in writing by the grantor.
If the permit holder violates the conditions of the permission, the grantor may revoke the permission immediately, and the permit holder shall remain liable for any damage caused to the grantor.
terms.note: The grantor may specify additional conditions in the permission.
